## Audit Report — 11 assigned files, 375px / 768px

### Findings

`components/outage-reporting.tsx:103` | **HIGH (tablet 768px)** | `"grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 gap-2 md:gap-3"` | At exactly 768px `md:` activates: main column = 720px (the `lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]` sidebar split has NOT kicked in yet), minus `CardContent` `px-6` = 672px, minus 5×12px gaps ÷ 6 = **102px per tile**; minus Button `md:px-4` = **70px content box**. Labels render at `md:text-sm` (14px) inside a Button whose base class is `whitespace-nowrap` — "Something else…" (~105px) and "Mobile App" (~72px) cannot wrap and cannot shrink, so tiles overflow their grid cells.

`components/outage-reporting.tsx:121` | **HIGH (tablet 768px)** | `"text-xs md:text-sm font-medium text-center"` | Root cause of the above — the span inherits `whitespace-nowrap` from `components/ui/button.tsx:8`, so `text-center` is inert and the 15-char label cannot break. (At 375px `grid-cols-2` gives 119px of content box vs ~90px of `text-xs` label, so **375px is fine** — this is a tablet-only defect.)

`components/outage-reporting.tsx:18-26` + `:103` | **MED (tablet)** | 7 items into `md:grid-cols-6` | Orphan 7th tile ("Something else…") sits alone on row 2 at full 102px width, ragged.

`app/status/[slug]/page.tsx:149` | **HIGH** | `"flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-border last:border-b-0 pb-2 last:pb-0"` | Component status row. `max-w-4xl px-4` → 343px, `section p-5` → 303px. Row = dot(8) + gap(12) + name + gap(12) + status badge(~80px) leaves **191px** for the name. The name span (line 161) is `flex-1` with **no `min-w-0`**, so its `min-width:auto` floors at min-content — an unbroken monitor name like `checkout.services.example.com` (~200px @14px) forces the row wider than 303px and produces page-level horizontal scroll. Verified there is **zero** `truncate`/`min-w-0`/`break-*`/`overflow-*`/`shrink-0` anywhere in this file (grep returned nothing).

`app/status/[slug]/page.tsx:161` | **HIGH** | `"text-sm flex-1"` | The offending span — needs `min-w-0 truncate` (or `break-all`) to be shrinkable. This is the highest-impact defect in the set: it is the public outage page most likely to be opened on a phone.

`app/status/[slug]/page.tsx:162-171` | **MED** | `"text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border "` (status pill) | No `shrink-0` and no `whitespace-nowrap`; it is the other half of the line-149 squeeze — it can be compressed below its label or contribute to the overflow depending on which side loses.

`components/comments-section.tsx:461` | **HIGH** | `"mt-3 flex items-center gap-4 text-xs"` | Top-level comment action bar, **no `flex-wrap`**. Available width at 375px: 343 (page `px-4`) → 295 (`CardContent px-6`) → 263 (`li p-4`). Contents: "▲ Same here · 128" button with `px-2 py-1 border` ≈118px + gap16 + "Reply" ≈32px + gap16 + "You flagged this" with Flag icon ≈100px = **282px > 263px** → overflows once a comment is flagged or the upvote count reaches 3 digits.

`components/comments-section.tsx:545` | **HIGH** | `"mt-2 flex items-center gap-4 text-xs"` | Reply action bar, same bug, tighter box: replies nest to 225px (263 − `pl-3`/`border-l-2` 14 − `li p-3` 24). Two controls = 118 + 16 + 100 = **234px > 225px** → overflows even with only two buttons.

`components/company-monitor-page.tsx:59` | **MED** | `"text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1 truncate"` | Single-line `truncate` on a 3-clause string (`{category} · {hostname} · Reports from real users, updated live.`). At 375px the parent has ~287px after the `w-14` logo + `gap-4`; the string is ~460px @14px, so the hostname — the one piece of identifying info — gets clipped mid-word. Should be `line-clamp-2` or unclamped on mobile.

`components/company-monitor-page.tsx:41` | **LOW** | `"text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4 flex items-center gap-1.5"` | Breadcrumb has no `flex-wrap` and no `min-w-0`/`truncate` on the trailing `{website.name}`; long service names push past 343px. `text-xs` keeps this cosmetic for most names in `data/websites.json`.

`app/status/[slug]/page.tsx:108` + `:116-118` | **LOW** | `"flex items-center gap-4 p-5 rounded-xl border "` / `"w-10 h-10 rounded-full grid place-items-center text-white font-bold "` | Status icon lacks `shrink-0`. The adjacent `h1` wraps so it rarely bites, but the circle is squashable to an ellipse if the headline ever contains a long unbreakable token.

`app/status/[slug]/page.tsx:200,214` | **LOW** | `"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap"` + `"text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-auto"` | Correctly wrapped, but at 375px (303px usable) badge(~90) + monitor name(~100) + `toLocaleString()` timestamp(~130) = 344px, so the timestamp always drops to its own line and `ml-auto` shoves it flush right, detached from its incident. Polish only.

---

### Verified NOT defects (hypotheses that did not hold)

- **Auth split-screen — does not exist.** `app/(auth)/layout.tsx` is a plain `min-h-screen flex flex-col` with `px-4`; there is no `grid-cols-2` hero/form split in any of the three auth files. Grep for `grid-cols-[2-9]` across both auth pages returned **nothing**.
- **No fixed-width form cards.** Grep for `w-[NNNpx]|min-w-[NNNpx]|max-w-[NNNpx]|h-[NNNpx]` across all 11 files returned only two hits, both benign vertical sizing: `components/comments-section.tsx:393` `min-h-[88px]` and `:506` `min-h-[60px]`. Zero fixed horizontal pixel widths anywhere.
- **Clerk `appearance` is clean.** `app/(auth)/sign-in/[[...sign-in]]/page.tsx:42-47` and `sign-up/…:41-46` both use `rootBox: "w-full max-w-md"` / `card: "w-full max-w-md p-6 md:p-8 …"` — fluid, no hardcoded pixels. Note `.env.local:5` contains a real `pk_test_…` key, so `HAS_CLERK` is true and the **Clerk branch is what actually renders** — `DevSignInForm`/`DevSignUpForm` are dead code in this environment. Caveat: `@clerk/clerk-js` is CDN-loaded (not in `node_modules`), so Clerk's internal default card width could not be inspected from source; the app-side override is correct either way.
- **Comments nesting is bounded to 2 levels — no compounding indentation.** `comments-section.tsx:452` maps top-level then `:536` maps `c.replies` (a flat `Comment[]`, not recursive — see the `CommentWithReplies` interface at line 24). Indentation is a single `pl-3` at line 535, not `ml-8`-per-level. The unbounded-nesting overflow hypothesis is **false**.
- **No tables and no 90-day uptime bars on the status page.** `app/status/[slug]/page.tsx` renders only `<ul>`/`<li>` rows; there is no `<table>` and no segment bar in the file, so the "min-width uptime bar" class of defect is absent here.
- **Correctly guarded responsive classes:** `company-monitor-page.tsx:93` `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]`, `:50` `flex flex-col md:flex-row`, `:56` `text-2xl md:text-3xl`, `:64` `flex flex-wrap`; `comments-section.tsx:366` `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2`, `:405` and `:427` both have `flex-wrap`; comment bodies at `:460`/`:544` have `break-words`.
- `app/status/layout.tsx`, `components/auth/clerk-provider.tsx`, `components/theme-provider.tsx`, `app/(public)/[company]/page.tsx` contain **no layout markup at all** (pass-through / metadata only) — nothing to audit.

### Priority order
1. `app/status/[slug]/page.tsx:161` — add `min-w-0 truncate` (public outage page, phone-first).
2. `components/comments-section.tsx:461` and `:545` — add `flex-wrap`.
3. `components/outage-reporting.tsx:103/121` — drop to `md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6` or add `whitespace-normal` to the label span.
4. `components/company-monitor-page.tsx:59` — `truncate` → `line-clamp-2`.

Second bucket in. Notably it **disproved** two hypotheses I'd seeded (no auth split-screen exists; comment nesting is bounded at 2 levels, not recursive) — good, that keeps the report honest. Two buckets outstanding.
